items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I was in there with Alvarez, Enrico Alvarez. We played dance music

ctx.x: Yes, I was in there with Alvarez, Enrico Alvarez. We played dance music, and of course Mike Durso had the show band, he played the dance music. That was only a trio, trumpet, bass -- or quartet, trumpet, bass, piano and drum. And Alvarez decided to go -- move to Puerto Rico, so during that time, when he left, well the whole band was going but Jack Silverman wanted me to stay. And I didn't want to stay because I said, I'm not Latin, I wouldn't fill the spot, so he said, well get some Latin musicians. So I did, I…
